title: The promote workflow is manually triggered and accepts an optional versionId input
asA: operator shipping a change to production
iWant: one promote workflow that ships the newest-of-main by default and accepts an explicit version id
soThat: the common ship, a hotfix, and a rollback all travel the same path

acceptanceCriteria.description: The `promote` workflow declares one input field `versionId` typed as an optional string.
acceptanceCriteria.then: one input `versionId` exists and is not marked required; the workflow declares no other input fields

acceptanceCriteria.description: A promote invocation with an empty `versionId` input resolves the newest-of-main by querying the Deploy Adapter's `resolveNewestOfMain` verb and then promotes THAT version.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the preview alias `main` currently resolves to version W
acceptanceCriteria.then: the workflow invokes `resolveNewestOfMain` returning W, calls `promoteVersion({ versionId: W })`, and the recorded promote record names W as `promotedVersionId`

acceptanceCriteria.description: A promote invocation whose input `versionId` is not present in `listVersions()` fails before calling `promoteVersion` and records nothing to the deploy log.
acceptanceCriteria.then: the run fails with the `DEPLOY_VERSION_NOT_FOUND` code from the adapter, no vendor promote call is issued, and no promote record is appended to the deploy log
